usedFor: Pitchit creates pitches and lead insights, and Memory stores them when “When a new pitch is created” runs “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new pitch is created” in Pitchit, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: The new pitch is saved as a key-value entry in Workspace Memory, so later steps can look it up.

watchOut: Choose “Delete Records” deliberately, since it deletes Workspace Memory entries and the insights trigger fires on each update.
